title: The Warded Mind Canon
summary: A canon of the settled ward that adds two heavy guards able to hold against a determined soul assault.

title: Treatise on Turning Soul Blows
summary: A treatise on meeting a soul blow at an angle and sending its weight wide of the mind.

title: Manual of the Shielded Spirit
summary: A manual of shielding the whole spirit and not the mind alone from a spread of soul force.

title: The Twin Ward Treatise
summary: A treatise on two wards held side by side so that a blow breaking one is caught by the other.

title: Hawk and Azure Veil Canon
summary: A canon of a high bright veil that sees an attack from far off and drops to meet it.

title: Compendium of the Paired Mantle
summary: A compendium on a mantle woven of two soul tracks that guards the mind and the body together.

title: The Wind-Sworn Guard Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of the guard sworn to the wind that gives way to every gust and never breaks.

title: Treatise on the Bearing of the Mind
summary: A treatise on taking a bearing for the mind and holding that line against any pull.

title: Oath Held Against the Gust
summary: A manual of the oath that keeps the soul unmoved while a storm of will blows across it.
